join hortbot 999 foobar 1

clock_set 2000-10-01T03:11:00Z

handle hortbot foobar/1 foobar/1 :!schedule add
send hortbot #foobar [HB] Usage: !schedule add <name> <pattern> [message difference]

handle hortbot foobar/1 foobar/1 :!schedule add repeatme
send hortbot #foobar [HB] Usage: !schedule add <name> <pattern> [message difference]

handle hortbot foobar/1 foobar/1 :!schedule add repeatme @hourly
send hortbot #foobar [HB] Command 'repeatme' does not exist.

handle hortbot foobar/1 foobar/1 :!schedule add repeatme @hourly 10
send hortbot #foobar [HB] Command 'repeatme' does not exist.


handle hortbot foobar/1 foobar/1 :!command add repeatme Hello there!
send hortbot #foobar [HB] Command 'repeatme' added, restricted to subscribers and above.


handle hortbot foobar/1 foobar/1 :!schedule add repeatme *_*_*_*_*
send hortbot #foobar [HB] Command 'repeatme' has been scheduled with '* * * * *' and will run if at least 1 message has passed.

handle hortbot foobar/1 foobar/1 :!schedule add repeatme *_*_*_*_* 2
send hortbot #foobar [HB] Command 'repeatme' has been scheduled with '* * * * *' and will run if at least 2 messages have passed.


handle hortbot foobar/1 foobar/1 :!schedule add repeatme what
send hortbot #foobar [HB] Bad cron expression: what


handle hortbot foobar/1 foobar/1 :!schedule add repeatme *_*_*_*_* 0
send hortbot #foobar [HB] Message difference must be at least 1.

handle hortbot foobar/1 foobar/1 :!schedule add repeatme *_*_*_*_* -1
send hortbot #foobar [HB] Message difference must be at least 1.

handle hortbot foobar/1 foobar/1 :!schedule add repeatme *_*_*_*_* huh
send hortbot #foobar [HB] Usage: !schedule add <name> <pattern> [message difference]


handle hortbot foobar/1 foobar/1 :!command addb repeatme2 Hello there!
send hortbot #foobar [HB] Command 'repeatme2' added, restricted to broadcasters and above.

handle hortbot foobar/1 modman/2 access=moderator :!schedule add repeatme2 *_*_*_*_*
send hortbot #foobar [HB] Command 'repeatme2' is restricted to broadcasters; only broadcasters and above can modify its schedule.
